verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
GGWE kibuga Beesirekemu-
Tukutunuulire;
Nga osiriikiridde nnyo
Mu maaso g'eggulu.
Mu nzikiza mu nguudo zo
-Omusana gwo guzze;
Byonna bye watyanga edda
Biweddewo leero.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Malyamu-azadde Kristo
Omutabaganya;
Abantu mu butamanya
Katonda-abaagala,
Ggwe Kristo-,era ggwe Kabaka
Tukusuute leero:
Oweebwenga ekitiibwa
Eyaleeta-essanyu.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Ayi Katonda nga watuwa
Yesu Omwana wo,
Kye kirabokyo-ekirungi
Ekyava mu ggulu.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Otuwe ffe aboonooyi
Okumukkiriza,
N'emyoyo emiwombeefu,
Ayingire mu ffe.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Ggwe-Omwana Omutukuvu
Jjangu-obeere mu ffe;
Otuggyeko-ebibi byonna
Ozaalibwe mu ffe.
Tuwulira bamalayika
Bayimba-eby'essanyu
Eby'Omulokozi w'ensi
Emanuweri waffe.
